The name is a beautiful combination of two syllables - 'Inta' and 'Ka'. The word 'Inta' signifies the rare and inimitable nature of life, a concept deeply ingrained in Hindu philosophy. The syllable 'Ka' alludes to the grace and beauty of Parvati, the consort of Shiva, who is also known as the goddess of love and beauty. Intika, as a name, represents the radiant and unique nature of every individual, echoing the values of inclusivity and diversity present in Hinduism.
